dct_description_sm: Biological samples and related ecological information were gathered from bowhead whales in Hudson Bay ecosystem, to develop a long-term dataset that can be used examine changes in marine mammal ecology resulting from climate change. This information will used in decision-making processes in the development of integrated management plans to ensure the sustainability of marine mammals distribution and abundance into the future.
dct_title_s: Global Warming and Arctic Marine Mammals (GWAMM) - Community-based montoring of bowhead whales in Foxe Basin, Igloolik, Nunavut, 2009
